chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Sinani (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Musa ibn Imran al-Nakhai narrated to us, from his uncle al-Husayn ibn Yazid, from Ali ibn Salim, from his father, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Aban ibn Taghlub, from Ikrima, from Ibn Abbas. He said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said:
God, exalted is His majesty, said: "Had all the people gathered upon the wilaya of Ali, I would not have created the Fire."

key_terms.النار: Al-Nar: the Hellfire, the abode of punishment in the afterlife
key_terms.ولاية: Wilaya: guardianship, spiritual authority, and allegiance to the divinely appointed leader

ai.seo_question: What did God say about the wilaya of Imam Ali and Hellfire?
ai.summary: In this hadith qudsi (divine saying), God Himself declares through the Prophet that if all of humanity had accepted the wilaya (spiritual authority and guardianship) of Ali ibn Abi Talib, Hellfire would have been unnecessary. This narration, recorded in the assembly of Shaykh al-Saduq in Mashhad in 368 AH, underscores the Shia theological position that the wilaya of Ali is the definitive criterion for salvation. The audience of scholars and students in Mashhad would have understood this as affirming that adherence to the divinely appointed Imams is the path to deliverance from punishment.
